We offer a unique take on the evening offshore adventure. You and your group will be treated to the rare experience of sailing a private yacht offshore Maui as the sun dips below the 3 Hours • Up to 6 People

All sails accommodate up to 6 guests, adults or 3-4 Hours • Up to 6 People

services.name: Private Day Sail
services.desc: Sailing off Lahaina and the west side of Maui offers some of the most scenic and exciting sailing in the world. You don’t want to miss this opportunity to learn from the best! 3 Hours About The Daytime Sailing Tour is great for groups or families of 6 looking to enjoy a few hours sailing around the Lahaina Coast. We can custom tailor a day on the water for you and your group during your Maui vacation. Depart historic Lahaina Harbor for your day on the water. Trips range from two to four hours and can feature whales, dolphins and beautiful scenery. Don’t forget your camera! All trips 3 Hours • Up to 6 People

quotes.author: Dana Tsubota
quotes.text: We had such a good time on this tour — the whole family was engaged and enjoyed learning the basics about sailing. We appreciated the confidence of instruction, the friendly atmosphere, and the amazing conversation with two wonderful humans with great stories about life on Maui. Would recommend without hesitation!

quotes.author: Holly Wilkes
quotes.text: Highly recommend taking a sail with the sweetest couple in Maui! The sailing experience was exactly what we hoped, a day at sea with the breeze in our hair. We snorkeled in a remote location, with no other boats. The best experience we could hope for, simply amazing! 🤩

quotes.author: Chad Grout
quotes.text: This was an incredible experience. We wanted to give our four kids (10-14) an authentic sailing experience and I cannot imagine how this could have been any better. Highly, highly recommend.

quotes.author: Nadia Yakoob
quotes.text: Amazing experience. The captain and Ali were very attentive and helpful. Loved the snorkeling. I highly recommend Gung-ho sailing if you want to avoid the large snorkeling tours.

quotes.author: Sherpa727190
quotes.text: We had a wonderful time sailing and snorkeling with GungHo Sailing! Highly recommend sailing with them!
